findings.quote: Frenchs Forest Precinct means the land identified on the Precincts Map as the Frenchs Forest Precinct.
findings.reasoning: This clause defines terms used in the LEP. It does not directly impact the assessment of the development itself.

findings.reasoning: The case record states a site-specific DCP has been adopted for the site. This satisfies the requirement for a DCP to be prepared for development within the Frenchs Forest Precinct.

findings.quote: Development consent must not be granted to development in relation to a building that is, or will, be higher than 12 metres or 3 storeys, or both, unless—(a) a design review panel has reviewed the development, and (b) the consent authority considers the findings of the panel.
findings.reasoning: The proposed building is 3 storeys and 11.5m high, triggering the requirement for review by a design review panel and consideration of their findings before consent can be granted.

findings.quote: Multi dwelling housing, residential flat buildings, shop top housing 1,400 square metres
findings.reasoning: The site area is 1500 sqm, which is greater than the minimum 1400 sqm required for a residential flat building on Site G in the R3 zone.

findings.quote: Residential flat buildings, shop top housing 30 metres
findings.reasoning: The site frontage is 30m, which meets the minimum 30m frontage requirement for residential flat buildings on Site G in the R3 zone.

findings.quote: Development consent must not be granted to development on Site F unless the consent authority is satisfied the development will not result in less than 5,500 square metres of deep soil zone in Site F.
findings.reasoning: This clause applies to Site F, but the subject site is Site G. Therefore, this clause is not applicable.

findings.quote: This clause applies to the following development—(a) development that is or involves the relocation of the Frenchs Forest Police Station to Site F...
findings.reasoning: This clause relates to the relocation of the Frenchs Forest Police Station to Site F, which is not the subject of this application.
